creative_objective: Tell the story with the breakfast plate instead of a body: before, the plate stays almost full; with the daily ritual, week after week, it ends up empty. Preserve the exact structure of the source: a light canvas split 2x2 by thick black lines, one bordered flat-illustration vignette per quadrant, a black rounded label with two lines of white text overlapping the top-right corner of each vignette, and the real bottle overlapping the bottom-right corner of the last quadrant.

art_direction.composition_style: Strict 2x2 grid. Each quadrant holds one square vignette placed slightly low and left inside it, with its black label riding over the vignette's top-right corner. The same top-down framing is repeated in the four vignettes so only the food on the plate changes.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: One thick vertical and one thick horizontal near-black line cross at the center of the canvas, edge to edge. Each vignette is about 37% of the canvas wide, with a cream margin around it inside its quadrant. Each label is about 23% of the canvas wide and 7% tall, with rounded corners, half over the vignette's top-right corner and half above it. The bottle is about 36% of the canvas height, its base near the bottom edge, covering the bottom-right corner of the fourth vignette.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Completely flat illustration with no shading gradients. Only the bottle is photorealistic, with soft studio light and a soft contact shadow, so it pops over the drawing.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 ad that looks like a four-panel comic, on a warm cream canvas (#FBF3DC). One thick near-black vertical line and one thick near-black horizontal line cross at the exact center and run edge to edge, dividing the canvas into four equal quadrants. Inside each quadrant there is one square vignette, about 37% of the canvas wide, placed slightly low and left within its quadrant, with a medium near-black border and a pale cream interior. All four vignettes show the SAME scene in the SAME framing, drawn as a clean flat vector-style illustration with even dark outlines and soft flat fills in cream, lemon yellow (#F2DC4A) and gold (#C9A441): a strict top-down (overhead) view of a breakfast table with a pale cream tablecloth with thin lemon-yellow stripes, a round white plate in the center, a glass of orange juice at the top right of the plate, and the two hands of a young woman with light-brown skin and short natural nails entering from the bottom edge. Only the food and the hands change. VIGNETTE 1 (top-left): the plate is almost full and untouched (a golden arepa, scrambled eggs, slices of avocado and fruit), the glass of juice is full, the fork lies beside the plate and her hands rest on the table away from the plate. VIGNETTE 2 (top-right): about a third of the food is gone, her right hand holds the fork over the plate, the juice is a little lower. VIGNETTE 3 (bottom-left): most of the food is gone and only a few bites remain, her right hand holds the fork and her left hand holds the half-empty glass. VIGNETTE 4 (bottom-right): the plate is clean and empty with the fork and knife resting together on it, the glass is empty, her hands rest relaxed beside the plate. LABELS: overlapping the top-right corner of each vignette (half over the vignette, half above it), a solid near-black rounded-rectangle label about 23% of the canvas wide, with two centered lines of bold white rounded sans-serif text. PRODUCT: in the bottom-right quadrant, the real product stands photorealistically over the bottom-right corner of the fourth vignette, front view, about 36% of the canvas height, its base near the bottom edge of the canvas, with a soft contact shadow; it does not cover the label of that quadrant or the empty plate. The product is a 60 ml (2 fl oz) amber-brown glass dropper bottle with rounded shoulders and a short neck, topped with a black ribbed screw collar and a glossy black rubber bulb dropper; the glass pipette is visible inside the amber liquid. A wraparound label covers most of the body with a smooth vertical gradient from bright lemon yellow at the top to white / pale silver at the bottom. On the label, from top to bottom: the lowercase black wordmark 'amua', the large white uppercase name 'VITALDROPS', a small dark line 'All-In-One Multi-Herbal Supplement', five small thin-outlined circular ingredient badges in two rows (A, MA, L on the first row; F, BR on the second) with tiny captions, and 'Dietary Supplement 2 fl. oz. (60mL)' at the bottom. The bottle is roughly 2.6 times taller than wide including the dropper. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret the bottle or its label. No bodies or silhouettes, no headline, no price, no button, no logo outside the product label, no arrows, no extra text.
